findings.problem: The hint does not rule out stoppen, which is just as common for stopping someone (Wir müssen ihn stoppen!), and zurückhalten is the more literal match for hold back, so the learner could give either word.
findings.fix: hint: keep someone from going on, also hold up or delay (not stoppen or anhalten)

back.target: to stop, to hold up, to delay (someone or something); reflexive sich aufhalten: to stay, to be somewhere

note: The common reflexive meaning sich aufhalten (to stay, to be somewhere) has no card, and the editor may want to add one later.
